text: The SDK utility object is reached through `sdk.client`, which `{module}`\ndoes not re-export: `(sdk.client/get-utility c
why: The word names the SDK utility object (get-utility, sdk.client), which every client has; it is the same word as the Utility entity of model B only by coincidence. The note is static, shown at the instance slot whatever the model, and true of the runtime (client.clj:69, core.clj:227). Re-keyed at v3.2: the note is now one plain string (it was two concatenated literals); the decision and its reason are unchanged.
